notes.title: Racing game《LOLI RACING》has been officially launched on Steam (Update 1.1.0)
notes.notes:
Kart racing game 《LOLI RACING》 was officially launched on Steam on February 29.


 Game content of official version 1.0.0 : 

 Single player and multiplayer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860907/2f19e26bd4ab84f3bfce9ff2497b5678034e5f29.png

 38 tracks with different themes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860907/05480af1327fed95371df57892064d8ba90a2bb1.png

 15 karts and characters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860907/ff177b0859baaa1b08e1eb08c7972216ec5a51d8.png

 Two modes : official match and practice match
